name: hollowrun
description: A zero-credential, local Steam idling tool for Windows that connects directly to your active Steam desktop client instance using Steamworks IPC.
author: ju6697

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build:worker: dotnet publish HollowRun.Worker/HollowRun.Worker.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -o HollowRun.Worker/publish
scripts.build:splash: dotnet publish HollowRun.Splash/HollowRun.Splash.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o HollowRun.Splash/publish
scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:splash && npm run generate:brand && npm run prepare:portable && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && node --test window-state.test.cjs startup-gate.test.cjs settings.test.cjs crash-reporting.test.cjs portable-relaunch.test.cjs local-service-client.test.cjs repository-config.test.cjs
